answer: An adversary as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 12 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The horizon counter is kept in crystal and nectar publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 12 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 28 dollars in locked collateral and another 4 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
